subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw land append mode through #77127, land the narrower #102243 branch, or request a different model-facing append API for #40001?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the long-term tool API or decide whether #77127's unrelated session-admission change belongs in the append fix.

options.title: Prefer narrower append branch
options.body: Use #102243 as the landing path after confirming or porting #77127's path-guard, queue, duplicate-append, and recovery coverage, then close #77127 as superseded after the replacement merges.

options.title: Land #77127 after owner review
options.body: Keep this branch if maintainers want its broader edge-case coverage, but split or explicitly approve the session-admission alias change before merge.

options.title: Request different append API
options.body: Ask contributors to replace append?: boolean with a dedicated append tool or another maintainer-approved contract before any branch lands.

recommendation.title: Prefer narrower append branch
recommendation.body: Use #102243 as the landing path after confirming or porting #77127's path-guard, queue, duplicate-append, and recovery coverage, then close #77127 as superseded after the replacement merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent history across agent tool contracts, tool catalog, and gateway session routing, which are the exact decision surfaces here.
